recipes/beef/best-at-home-steak.html.body_html:
Ingredients

Steak, cut and amount unspecified|Olive oil for coating|Garlic-infused extra-virgin olive oil for basting|Sugar, small amount suggested|Seasoning blend

  • 3 tbsp coarsely ground mixed black, white, green, and pink peppercorns
  • 2 tsp kosher salt
  • 1/8 tsp ground red pepper

Instructions

  1. Heat oven to 325 F. Coat steak with olive oil and seasoning; a small amount of sugar is suggested for browning.
  2. Sear in a hot skillet 2 minutes per side, then transfer to a rack over a shallow pan and baste with garlic-infused oil.
  3. Finish in the oven up to 25-30 minutes; the original calls 140 F medium.

Source limitation / note: The source gives no steak size or oil quantity, mentions reserving 2 tsp seasoning for an unspecified steak sauce, and uses a 140 F target. USDA guidance for whole beef steaks is 145 F followed by a 3-minute rest.

Attribution: Source quotes Ms. Anderson and chef Richard Chamberlain.

Source: Beef\Best At Home Steak.docx. Ingredient facts reviewed from the supplied source; directions independently summarized. Original file unchanged.

Additional source facts: Chamberlain notes that bone-in steaks cook more slowly. T-bone comes from the center of the short loin; porterhouse includes the tenderloin tip; New York strip is also called Kansas City steak; rib-eye is also called Delmonico and may be bone-in. The original offers a roughly 10-minute holding interval with the oven switched off and door ajar; that is a source suggestion, not a verified safe holding specification.

recipes/beef/finger-steaks.html.body_html:
Ingredients

  • 1 1/2 lb round steak
  • 1/2 cup ketchup or tomato sauce
  • 1/4-1/2 cup vinegar
  • 1 tsp salt
  • Dash Tabasco
  • Garlic salt, amount unspecified
  • 1 tsp pepper
  • 2 cups flour
  • 3 tbsp oil

Instructions

  1. Cut the steak into cubes.
  2. Combine the sauce ingredients. Dip steak in sauce, then flour; fry in the oil.

Source limitation / note: The card gives no frying time or temperature.

Attribution: Kristine Stapleman (handwritten card)

Recipe source: More Recipes / Beef / Finger Steaks.pdf. Original source files are unchanged.

recipes/beef/pumpkin-dinner.html.body_html:
Ingredients

  • 1 medium pumpkin
  • 2 lb ground beef
  • 2 tbsp brown sugar
  • 3/4 cup chopped onion
  • 2 tbsp soy sauce
  • 4 oz mushrooms
  • 1 can cream of mushroom or chicken soup, size unspecified
  • 1 1/2 cups cooked rice
  • 1 can water chestnuts, size unspecified

Instructions

  1. Saute the onion, brown the beef, and drain excess fat.
  2. Mix the meat and onion with soy sauce, sugar, mushrooms, chestnuts, soup, and rice.
  3. Fill the pumpkin, place it on a cookie sheet, and cook for 1 hour.

Source limitation / note: Incomplete source: oven temperature, can sizes, and pumpkin-opening instructions are not supplied. Do not treat the stated hour as a complete cooking specification.

Recipe source: More Recipes / Beef / Pumpkin Dinner.pdf. Original source files are unchanged.

recipes/breads/african-flat-bread.html.body_html:
Ingredients

  • 4 tsp active dry yeast
  • 2 tsp sugar
  • 2 cups warm water, about 110 F
  • 4 cups all-purpose flour, plus more for kneading
  • 2 tsp salt
  • 1 cup clarified butter or vegetable oil, plus 1 tsp

Instructions

  1. Let yeast, sugar, and water foam for about 5 minutes.
  2. Combine flour and salt with the yeast mixture and the cup of butter or oil. Knead for 3 minutes.
  3. Grease a bowl with the remaining teaspoon of butter or oil. Let the covered dough double, about 1 hour.
  4. Heat oven to 400 F. Make 24 circles and bake on a stone or lightly greased sheet for about 12 minutes, until golden and puffed. Serve warm.

Recipe source: More Recipes / Breads / African Flat Bread.pdf. Original source files are unchanged.

recipes/breads/cranberry-nut-bread.html.body_html:
Ingredients

  • Nonstick cooking spray
  • 1 cup all-purpose flour
  • 1/2 cup whole-wheat flour
  • 1 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 1/2 tsp cinnamon
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 tsp baking soda
  • 3 egg whites
  • 1/3 cup applesauce
  • 3 tbsp buttermilk
  • 1 1/2 cups fresh cranberries
  • 1/2 cup chopped walnuts

Instructions

  1. Heat oven to 350 F and lightly spray a loaf pan.
  2. Combine flours, sugar, cinnamon, salt, and soda. Beat egg whites on high for 1 minute, then beat in applesauce and buttermilk. Gradually beat in the flour mixture just until combined; stir in cranberries and walnuts.
  3. Transfer to the prepared pan. Bake 45 minutes, or until edges pull away and a toothpick comes out clean. Slice and serve.

Source limitation / note: Source yield: 12 one-slice servings. Prep: 15 minutes; bake: 45 minutes. Nutrition per serving as supplied: 166 calories; 3.2 g fat (0.3 g saturated); 31.6 g carbohydrate; 4.1 g protein; 1.8 g fiber; energy distribution 17% fat, 73% carbohydrate, 10% protein. Sodium and calcium are not available. Decorative web-layout tables are not ingredients.

Source: Breads\Cranberry Nut Bread.docx. Ingredient facts reviewed from the supplied source; directions independently summarized. Original file unchanged.

recipes/desserts/vanilla-buttercream-cak.body_html:
Ingredients

  • 2 1/2 sticks butter, removed from refrigerator 30 minutes before use
  • 5 1/2 cups powdered sugar
  • 1 tbsp vanilla
  • 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream, plus more if needed

Instructions

  1. Whip until the frosting is soft, fluffy, and easy to spread.

Source limitation / note: The card gives no mixing sequence or whipping duration. It notes that longer whipping makes the frosting whiter.

Attribution: Cakes by Rayno

recipes/desserts/wonderful-stuff.html.body_html:
Ingredients

Cereal mixture

  • 9 cups Golden Graham cereal
  • 8 cups Corn Chex
  • 2 cups coconut
  • 1 cup almonds

Syrup

  • 1 cup sugar
  • 1 cup Karo syrup
  • 3/4 cup butter or margarine (1 1/2 squares)

Instructions

  1. Combine the cereals, coconut, and almonds.
  2. Boil the syrup ingredients for 2 minutes. Pour over the cereal mixture and stir.
  3. Let the mixture dry slightly before storing.

Source limitation / note: The source allows other cereals or nuts as additions or substitutes.

Recipe source: More Recipes / Desserts / Wonderful Stuff.pdf. Original source files are unchanged.

recipes/desserts/cakes/a-very-berry-stra.body_html:
Ingredients

Cake

  • 1 packaged white cake mix
  • 1 cup vegetable oil
  • 1 package strawberry Jell-O
  • 4 eggs
  • 8-10 oz frozen strawberries with juice

Icing

  • 7-10 large strawberries
  • 4 tbsp sugar, to taste
  • 1/4 cup water, or more if needed

Instructions

  1. Heat oven to 350 F; grease and flour a Bundt pan.
  2. Beat cake mix, oil, eggs, and gelatin until smooth. Stir in frozen strawberries and juice.
  3. Bake about 40 minutes, checking with a toothpick.
  4. Blend the icing strawberries, sugar, and water. Poke holes in the cake with a fork and pour on the blended icing.

Source limitation / note: Cake-mix and gelatin package sizes are not specified.

Source: Desserts\Cakes\A Very Berry Strawberry Bunt Cake.pdf. Ingredient facts reviewed from the supplied source; directions independently summarized. Original file unchanged.

recipes/desserts/cakes/luscious-four-lay.body_html:
Ingredients

  • 1 package yellow cake mix, 2-layer style
  • 1 can (15 oz) pumpkin, divided
  • 1 egg, beaten (separately listed in source)
  • 1/2 cup milk
  • 1/3 vegetable oil, unit missing
  • 4 large eggs
  • 1 1/2 tsp pumpkin pie spice, divided
  • 1 package (8 oz) cream cheese, softened
  • 1 cup powdered sugar
  • 1 tub (8 oz) whipped topping, thawed
  • 1/4 cup caramel topping
  • 1/2 cup pecans

Instructions

  1. Heat oven to 350 F; grease and flour two 9-inch round pans.
  2. Mix cake mix, 1 cup pumpkin, milk, oil, eggs, and 1 tsp spice. Divide between pans and bake 20-22 minutes; check with a toothpick. Cool completely.
  3. Beat cream cheese with powdered sugar, the remaining pumpkin and remaining spice; fold in whipped topping.
  4. Split each cake into two layers. Fill between layers, leaving the top unfrosted; add caramel and pecans. Refrigerate.

Source limitation / note: Incomplete source: oil has no unit; the list contains both one beaten egg and four large eggs but does not distinguish their uses. No guessed correction is made.

Source: Desserts\Cakes\Luscious Four-Layer Pumpkin Cake.pdf. Ingredient facts reviewed from the supplied source; directions independently summarized. Original file unchanged.

recipes/desserts/cakes/molten-lava-cake..body_html:
Ingredients

  • 2 cups chocolate chips
  • 1 cup butter
  • 2 cups powdered sugar
  • 6 eggs
  • 2 egg yolks
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
  • 12 tbsp flour
  • Caramel sauce for drizzling
  • Ice cream
  • Smuckers Chocolate Magic Shell for drizzling
  • Cooking spray

Instructions

  1. Heat oven to 400 F. Microwave chocolate and butter for 2 minutes, then whisk smooth.
  2. Stir in powdered sugar, eggs and yolks, vanilla, and flour.
  3. Spray four 1-cup oven-safe cups and divide batter between them, as the source specifies. Bake on a sheet for 13-15 minutes until edges set and centers remain soft.
  4. Rest 2-3 minutes, invert, and serve with caramel, ice cream, and chocolate topping.

Source limitation / note: The source is labeled double batch but still specifies four 1-cup cups; this yield/capacity conflict is unresolved. Use pasteurized eggs where centers remain undercooked.

Source: Desserts\Cakes\Molten Lava Cake.pdf. Ingredient facts reviewed from the supplied source; directions independently summarized. Original file unchanged.

recipes/desserts/cakes/to-die-for-carrot.body_html:
Ingredients

Cake, group 1

  • 1 1/4 cups unsweetened applesauce or oil
  • 2 cups granulated sugar
  • 3 room-temperature eggs

Cake, group 2

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1 tsp baking soda
  • 1 1/2 tsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1 tsp cinnamon

Cake, group 3

  • 2 cups grated carrots
  • 1 cup sweetened shredded coconut
  • 1 cup chopped nuts, optional
  • 1 tsp vanilla
  • 1 cup crushed pineapple in juice, undrained

Frosting

  • 1/2 cup softened butter
  • 8 oz softened cream cheese
  • 1 tsp vanilla
  • 1 lb powdered sugar
  • Toasted pecans or coconut for topping, optional

Instructions

  1. Heat oven to 350 F. Combine group 1, then mix in group 2; stir in group 3.
  2. Use a lightly greased 9-by-13-inch pan, two 9-inch rounds, or three 8-inch rounds; parchment on the bottom helps release the cake.
  3. Bake 35-40 minutes for the 9-by-13-inch or 9-inch pans, or 25-30 minutes for 8-inch pans. Check with a toothpick.
  4. Cool in pans 10 minutes, then transfer to racks and cool completely.
  5. Beat frosting butter and cream cheese together, then beat in vanilla and powdered sugar until smooth.

Source limitation / note: Source yield: 16 slices. Its 25-minute metadata is not the bake time for every pan size.

Attribution: Trish, Mom On Timeout

Source: Desserts\Cakes\To Die For Carrot Cake.pdf. Ingredient facts reviewed from the supplied source; directions independently summarized. Original file unchanged.

recipes/desserts/cakes/tres-leches.html.body_html:
Ingredients

Cake

  • 6 eggs, separated
  • 2 cups sugar
  • 1 tsp vanilla
  • 3 tsp baking powder
  • 3 cups flour
  • 1/2 cup milk

Filling

  • 2 cans (12 oz each) evaporated milk
  • 2 cans (16 oz each, as stated) sweetened condensed milk
  • 2 cups milk
  • 6 egg yolks

Frosting alternatives

  • 1 package whipped topping, size unspecified; or homemade whipped cream; or the following frosting
  • 1 cup sugar
  • 1/2 cup honey
  • 3 egg whites
  • 1 tsp vanilla
  • Strawberries or other fruit, optional

Instructions

  1. Heat oven to 350 F. Whip cake whites to peaks. Gradually mix in yolks, sugar, vanilla, and baking powder, then add flour and milk gradually.
  2. Bake in a 15-by-10-inch pan about 30 minutes; pierce the cake every inch with a fork.
  3. Blend filling ingredients and pour over the cake.
  4. Use one frosting alternative. For the honey frosting, stir sugar and honey together over low heat, then cook without stirring about 6 minutes until bubbling and a drop hardens in water. Beat whites to peaks; combine with the syrup and beat thick.
  5. Freeze the frosted cake until 30 minutes before serving; add fruit if desired.

Source limitation / note: The source does not specify how vanilla is added to the honey frosting or a precise syrup temperature. Filling contains uncooked yolks; use pasteurized eggs. Condensed-milk can size is preserved as stated, not corrected.

Source: Desserts\Cakes\Tres Leches.pdf. Ingredient facts reviewed from the supplied source; directions independently summarized. Original file unchanged.

recipes/desserts/cakes/white-texas-sheet.body_html:
Ingredients

Cake

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 2 cups sugar
  • 1 tsp baking powder
  • 1 tsp salt
  • 1/4 tsp baking soda
  • 1 cup cubed butter
  • 1 cup water
  • 2 large room-temperature eggs
  • 1/2 cup sour cream
  • 1 tsp almond extract

Frosting

  • 1/2 cup cubed butter
  • 1/4 cup 2% milk
  • 4 1/2 cups confectioners' sugar
  • 1/2 tsp almond extract
  • 1 cup chopped walnuts

Instructions

  1. Heat oven to 375 F and grease a 15-by-10-by-1-inch pan.
  2. Whisk dry cake ingredients. Bring butter and water just to a boil; stir into the dry mixture. Whisk eggs, sour cream, and extract separately, then whisk into batter.
  3. Bake 18-22 minutes, checking with a toothpick; cool 20 minutes.
  4. Bring frosting butter and milk just to a boil. Off the heat, stir in sugar and extract gradually, then walnuts. Spread on the warm cake.

Source limitation / note: Yield: 20 servings.

Attribution: Joanie Ward, Taste of Home

Source: Desserts\Cakes\White Texas Sheet Cake.pdf. Ingredient facts reviewed from the supplied source; directions independently summarized. Original file unchanged.

recipes/desserts/candies/chocolate-truff.body_html:
Ingredients

Ganache

  • Generous 2 cups (18 oz; 500 g) heavy cream
  • 21 oz (600 g) finely chopped bittersweet chocolate
  • Generous 1/4 cup (2 oz; 60 g) Grand Marnier or Stoli Razberi vodka, optional

Coating

  • 18 oz (500 g) tempered bittersweet chocolate
  • 18 oz (500 g) tempered white chocolate

Garnishes

  • 2 cups (8 oz; 230 g) sifted Dutch-process cocoa
  • 2 1/2 cups (9 oz; 250 g) toasted sweetened shredded coconut
  • About 2 cups (8 oz; 230 g) finely chopped toasted nuts

Instructions

  1. Heat cream until bubbles appear at the saucepan edge. Pour half over chopped chocolate, wait 30 seconds, and whisk smooth. Gradually incorporate the rest of the cream, then optional flavoring.
  2. Spread ganache on a plastic-wrap-lined sheet, cover, and let set at least 4 hours until pipeable.
  3. Pipe or spoon 1-inch mounds, spaced 1 inch apart. Let firm for a couple of hours, or refrigerate 15 minutes, then roll into balls.
  4. If too soft to dip, refrigerate 1-2 hours. Dip in the tempered coating of choice, drain, and apply garnish before chocolate sets. Hand-coated truffles need a second coating; let set about 5 minutes.
  5. For coconut, toast at 400 F about 3 minutes, stir, and toast about 3 more minutes to golden. Toast nuts at 300 F about 30 minutes; cool before use.

Source limitation / note: Yield stated: about 180. Tempering narrative is not reproduced; coatings must already be tempered. The author's name is not visible in the supplied PDF.

Source: Desserts\Candies\Chocolate Truffles.pdf. Ingredient facts reviewed from the supplied source; directions independently summarized. Original file unchanged.

recipes/desserts/candies/microwave-prali.body_html:
Ingredients

  • 2 cups pecan halves
  • 1/2 cup butter
  • 2/3 cup brown sugar
  • 14 oz sweetened condensed milk
  • 1 tsp vanilla

Instructions

  1. Microwave pecans in a glass pie plate for 5 minutes, stirring every 2 minutes.
  2. In an 8-cup microwave-safe measure, melt butter for 1 minute. Stir in sugar and milk; microwave 6 minutes, stirring every 2 minutes. The source warns of boil-over.
  3. Beat about 3 minutes, stir in pecans and vanilla, and quickly spoon onto wax paper to cool.

Source limitation / note: Microwave power is unspecified; use caution with hot syrup and boil-over.

Source: Desserts\Candies\Microwave Praline Candy.pdf. Ingredient facts reviewed from the supplied source; directions independently summarized. Original file unchanged.

recipes/desserts/candies/sees-fudge.html.body_html:
Ingredients

  • 1 cup butter
  • 12 oz chocolate chips
  • 2 eggs
  • 1 lb powdered sugar
  • 1 tsp vanilla
  • 1 cup broken nuts

Instructions

  1. Melt butter and chocolate together.
  2. Beat eggs fluffy; mix in powdered sugar, vanilla, and nuts, then combine with melted chocolate.
  3. Pour into a buttered pan and let set.

Source limitation / note: This source has uncooked eggs; use pasteurized eggs. Pan size and setting time are unspecified.

Source: Desserts\Candies\See's Fudge.pdf. Ingredient facts reviewed from the supplied source; directions independently summarized. Original file unchanged.

recipes/desserts/cookies/almond-joy-cook.body_html:
Ingredients

  • 1 cup softened salted butter
  • 1 1/2 cups white sugar
  • 2 eggs
  • 2 1/4 cups flour
  • 1 tsp baking soda
  • 1 tsp salt
  • 2 1/2 cups sweetened shredded coconut
  • 1 1/2 bags chocolate chips (3 cups)
  • 2 cups peeled slivered almonds

Instructions

  1. Heat oven to 350 F and line two sheets with parchment or silicone mats.
  2. Cream butter and sugar, then beat in eggs. Combine flour, soda, and salt separately; mix into the butter mixture.
  3. Fold in coconut, chips, and almonds. Scoop onto sheets and bake about 10 minutes; centers may look soft and firm as they cool.

Source: Desserts\Cookies\Almond Joy Cookies.pdf. Ingredient facts reviewed from the supplied source; directions independently summarized. Original file unchanged.

recipes/desserts/cookies/brown-butter-bl.body_html:
Ingredients

Blondies

  • 1 cup unsalted butter
  • 1 3/4 cups dark brown sugar
  • 2 large room-temperature eggs
  • 2 tsp vanilla
  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 3/4 tsp fine sea salt

Almond caramel

  • 3 cups sliced almonds
  • 1/2 cup cubed butter
  • 1/2 cup light brown sugar
  • 1/4 cup honey
  • 1/3 cup heavy cream

Instructions

  1. Heat oven to 350 F; line or butter and flour an 8-inch square pan.
  2. Brown blondie butter about 5 minutes, then cool about 20 minutes. Beat with sugar, eggs, and vanilla; fold in flour and salt.
  3. Bake batter 20 minutes until the center is no longer liquid; toast almonds about 5 minutes.
  4. Heat caramel butter, sugar, honey, and cream over medium-high heat without stirring for about 7 minutes to boiling. Add almonds, spread over the prebaked blondie, and bake 10 more minutes. Cool.

Source limitation / note: The source gives a candy-thermometer value of 116 without a unit. That ambiguous target is not guessed or converted.

Attribution: Adapted from Untitled at the Whitney, New York (supplied source)

Source: Desserts\Cookies\Brown-Butter Blondies With Caramel Almonds.pdf. Ingredient facts reviewed from the supplied source; directions independently summarized. Original file unchanged.

recipes/desserts/cookies/carols-sugar-co.body_html:
Ingredients

  • 2 cups sugar
  • 1 cup butter
  • 2 eggs
  • 2 tsp vanilla
  • 1 cup buttermilk
  • 6 cups flour
  • 2 tsp soda
  • 1 tsp salt

Instructions

  1. Cream butter with sugar; mix in eggs, then vanilla and buttermilk. Add the dry ingredients.
  2. Chill overnight and roll 1/4 inch thick.
  3. Bake at 375 F about 8 minutes, until bottoms are golden; cool, frost, and decorate.

Source limitation / note: Frosting is mentioned but no formula is supplied.

Source: Desserts\Cookies\Carol's Sugar Cookies.pdf. Ingredient facts reviewed from the supplied source; directions independently summarized. Original file unchanged.

recipes/desserts/cookies/chinese-butter-.body_html:
Ingredients

  • 12 tbsp (1 1/2 sticks) softened unsalted butter
  • 3/4 cup powdered sugar
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 tsp vanilla
  • 1 1/2 cups self-rising flour; source alternative: 1 1/2 cups flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp salt

Instructions

  1. Heat oven to 375 F and line a sheet with parchment.
  2. Cream butter smooth, then beat in sugar until fluffy; add egg and vanilla. Sift in flour slowly and mix smooth.
  3. Shape flowers, leaving 1 inch around cookies. Bake 12-15 minutes until lightly golden, then cool on a rack.

Source limitation / note: Source yield: about 40 small cookies, or approximately 12 larger cookies.

Source: Desserts\Cookies\Chinese Butter Cookies.pdf. Ingredient facts reviewed from the supplied source; directions independently summarized. Original file unchanged.

recipes/desserts/cookies/coconut-chews.h.body_html:
Ingredients

Crust

  • 1/2 cup butter
  • 2 tbsp sugar
  • 1 cup flour
  • Pinch salt

Topping

  • 1 1/2 cups brown sugar
  • 2 eggs
  • 2 tsp vanilla
  • 1 cup flaked coconut
  • 1 cup chopped nuts

Instructions

  1. Cut butter into flour, granulated sugar, and salt. Press into the source's 9.13 baking pan and bake at 350 F for 15 minutes.
  2. Beat brown sugar with eggs; add vanilla, coconut, and nuts. Spread over crust and bake 25 more minutes.
  3. Cut while warm; cool before covering.

Source limitation / note: The printed pan dimension is '9.13'; it is not silently interpreted or corrected.

Source: Desserts\Cookies\Coconut Chews.pdf. Ingredient facts reviewed from the supplied source; directions independently summarized. Original file unchanged.

recipes/desserts/cookies/coconut-macaroo.body_html:
Ingredients

  • 14 oz flaked coconut
  • 1/4 tsp salt
  • 2 1/2 tsp vanilla
  • 4 tbsp margarine or butter
  • 1 cup flour
  • 1 can (14 oz) sweetened condensed milk
  • 1 cup semisweet chocolate chips

Instructions

  1. Mix coconut, flour, and salt; stir in condensed milk and vanilla.
  2. Drop rounded spoonfuls on a well-greased sheet. Bake at 375 F 12-13 minutes until some coconut is toasted; cool.
  3. Microwave chips with butter or margarine 1-2 minutes and stir smooth. Dip half of each cookie, then refrigerate on a plastic-wrap-covered sheet.

Source: Desserts\Cookies\Coconut Macaroons.pdf. Ingredient facts reviewed from the supplied source; directions independently summarized. Original file unchanged.

recipes/desserts/cookies/cookie-bars.htm.body_html:
Ingredients

  • 2 sticks salted butter
  • 3/4 cup brown sugar
  • 3/4 cup white sugar
  • 1 tsp vanilla
  • 2 eggs
  • 2 1/4 cups flour
  • 1/2 tsp cornstarch
  • 3/4 tsp salt
  • 3/4 tsp baking soda
  • 1 bag milk chocolate chips, size unspecified

Instructions

  1. Cream butter and sugars with vanilla and eggs in the mixing bowl.
  2. Mix in the remaining ingredients and spread evenly in a greased Texas Brownies pan.
  3. Bake at 375 F for 20-30 minutes, until evenly golden.

Source limitation / note: Source label: half batch. Pan dimensions and chip bag size are not given.

Attribution: Tara John

Source: Desserts\Cookies\Cookie Bars.pdf. Ingredient facts reviewed from the supplied source; directions independently summarized. Original file unchanged.

recipes/desserts/cookies/date-balls.html.body_html:
Ingredients

  • 2 sticks butter
  • 2 small packages chopped dates
  • 2 cups chopped pecans
  • 10x powdered sugar, amount unspecified
  • 2 cups brown sugar
  • 1 small package coconut flakes
  • 4 cups Rice Krispies

Instructions

  1. Heat butter and brown sugar in a heavy pan until sugar melts; add dates and coconut and cook 6 minutes.
  2. Off heat, stir in pecans and cereal, adding the cereal in two portions.
  3. Roll into small balls and coat in powdered sugar.

Source limitation / note: Small-package sizes are unspecified; '10x' identifies powdered sugar, not a quantity.

Source: Desserts\Cookies\Date Balls.pdf. Ingredient facts reviewed from the supplied source; directions independently summarized. Original file unchanged.

recipes/desserts/cookies/doubletree-choc.body_html:
Ingredients

  • 1/2 lb softened butter (2 sticks)
  • 3/4 cup plus 1 tbsp granulated sugar
  • 3/4 cup packed light brown sugar
  • 2 large eggs
  • 1 1/4 tsp vanilla
  • 1/4 tsp fresh lemon juice
  • 2 1/4 cups flour
  • 1/2 cup rolled oats
  • 1 tsp baking soda
  • 1 tsp salt
  • Pinch cinnamon
  • 2 2/3 cups Nestle Tollhouse semisweet chocolate chips
  • 1 3/4 cups chopped walnuts

Instructions

  1. Cream butter and sugars on medium about 2 minutes. Add eggs, vanilla, and lemon juice; mix low for 30 seconds, then medium about 2 minutes.
  2. Mix flour, oats, soda, salt, and cinnamon in on low about 45 seconds; avoid overmixing. Fold in chips and walnuts.
  3. Scoop approximately 3 tbsp portions onto parchment, 2 inches apart.
  4. Bake at 300 F for 20-23 minutes until edges are golden but centers remain soft; cool on the sheet about 1 hour.

Source limitation / note: Makes 26. Unbaked portions can be frozen and baked at 300 F without thawing, checking doneness rather than assuming the same bake time.

Attribution: DoubleTree Signature Cookie Recipe

Source: Desserts\Cookies\Doubletree Chocolate Chips.pdf. Ingredient facts reviewed from the supplied source; directions independently summarized. Original file unchanged.

recipes/desserts/cookies/magic-bars.html.body_html:
Ingredients

  • 3 cups graham cracker crumbs
  • 1/2 cup melted butter
  • 12 oz chocolate chips
  • 12 oz butterscotch chips
  • 1 cup chopped walnuts
  • 12 oz shredded coconut
  • 1 can sweetened condensed milk, size unspecified

Instructions

  1. Heat oven to 350 F. Use the stated 9-by-11 1/2-by-3-inch pan.
  2. Press crumbs and butter into the pan; bake 7 minutes. Layer chips, coconut, and walnuts, then pour condensed milk evenly over them.
  3. Bake about 40 minutes, until the center and top are golden and cooked through.

Source limitation / note: Source permits ingredient amounts to vary and warns that bake time varies. Condensed-milk can size is unspecified.

Source: Desserts\Cookies\Magic Bars.pdf. Ingredient facts reviewed from the supplied source; directions independently summarized. Original file unchanged.

recipes/desserts/cookies/neiman-marcus-c.body_html:
Ingredients

  • 1 cup butter
  • 1 cup sugar
  • 1 cup brown sugar
  • 2 eggs
  • 1 tsp vanilla
  • 2 cups flour
  • 2 1/2 cups oatmeal
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1 tbsp baking soda
  • 12 oz chocolate chips
  • 1 1/2 cups chopped nuts
  • 1 cup coconut

Instructions

  1. Cream butter and both sugars; add eggs and vanilla.
  2. Mix in flour, oatmeal, salt, baking powder, and soda; then fold in chips, nuts, and coconut.
  3. Roll into balls, place 2 inches apart, and bake at 375 F about 10 minutes.

Source limitation / note: Source label: half batch; makes about 48.

Source: Desserts\Cookies\Neiman-Marcus Cookies.pdf. Ingredient facts reviewed from the supplied source; directions independently summarized. Original file unchanged.

  • 1/2 tsp vanilla
  • 1 cup flour

  • 1/4 tsp salt

recipes/desserts/cookies/no-bake-cookies.body_html:
Ingredients

  • 2 cups sugar
  • 1/2 cup milk
  • 1/2 cup butter
  • 3 tbsp cocoa
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 3 cups oats
  • 1 cup coconut
  • 1 tsp vanilla

Instructions

  1. Bring sugar, milk, butter, cocoa, and salt to a boil in a saucepan.
  2. Off heat, stir in oats, coconut, and vanilla. Spoon onto wax paper or spread in a pan; let cool.

Source: Desserts\Cookies\No Bake Cookies.pdf. Ingredient facts reviewed from the supplied source; directions independently summarized. Original file unchanged.

recipes/desserts/cookies/nobake-peanut-b.body_html:
Ingredients

  • 1/2 cup (8 tbsp; 113 g) melted salted butter
  • 1 cup (120 g) graham cracker crumbs
  • 2 cups (240 g) confectioners' sugar
  • 1 cup plus 2 tbsp (280 g) creamy peanut butter, divided
  • 1 cup (180 g) semisweet chocolate chips

Instructions

  1. Line an 8- or 9-inch square pan with parchment or foil.
  2. Mix butter, crumbs, and sugar; stir in 1 cup (250 g) peanut butter and press evenly into the pan.
  3. Melt chips with the remaining 2 tbsp peanut butter, stir smooth, and spread on the base.
  4. Refrigerate at least 2 hours until firm; rest at room temperature 10 minutes before cutting. Serve chilled.

Source limitation / note: Makes 20-24 squares. Keep tightly covered up to 1 week refrigerated or 3 months frozen; thaw refrigerated. Unsalted butter alternative: add 1/4 tsp salt. Use processed creamy peanut butter rather than oily natural peanut butter; 120 g digestive biscuits can replace graham crumbs.

Attribution: Sally, Sally's Baking Addiction; https://sallysbakingaddiction.com/no-bake-chocolate-peanut-butter-bars/

Source: Desserts\Cookies\Nobake Peanut Butter Bars.pdf. Ingredient facts reviewed from the supplied source; directions independently summarized. Original file unchanged.

recipes/desserts/cookies/peanut-butter-m.body_html:
Ingredients

  • 1 cup flour
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 tsp baking soda
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter
  • 3/4 cup peanut butter
  • 1/2 cup brown sugar
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 1/2 tsp vanilla
  • 2 cups mini peanut butter cups, halved
  • 2/3 cup peanut butter/chocolate chips
  • Reese's Pieces or mini Reese's Pieces, amount unspecified

Instructions

  1. Heat oven to 325 F; line sheets with parchment. Sift flour, salt, and soda together.
  2. Beat butter, peanut butter, and sugars about 1 minute; beat in egg and vanilla about 1 minute.
  3. Mix in flour on low, then gently fold in cups and chips.
  4. Dip heaping tablespoon portions in candy pieces and place 3-4 inches apart.
  5. Bake about 15 minutes, until lightly golden with a few cracks; do not overbake.

Source: Desserts\Cookies\Peanut Butter Monster Cookies.pdf. Ingredient facts reviewed from the supplied source; directions independently summarized. Original file unchanged.

recipes/desserts/cookies/pecan-coconut-t.body_html:
Ingredients

Crust

  • 2 cups flour
  • 1/2 cup powdered sugar
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 3/4 cup butter

Filling

  • 2 eggs
  • 1/2 cup packed brown sugar
  • 1 cup chopped pecans
  • 3/4 cup coconut
  • 1/2 cup honey
  • 1/4 cup melted butter
  • 2 tbsp light cream
  • 1 tsp vanilla

Instructions

  1. Mix crust flour, sugar, and salt; cut in butter until crumbly. Press into a 9-by-13-inch pan; bake at 350 F 10 minutes.
  2. Beat eggs lightly and stir in brown sugar, pecans, honey, and melted butter. Mix cream with vanilla and stir into filling.
  3. Spread over hot crust and bake 20 more minutes until set. Cool on a rack; cut squares diagonally into triangles.

Source limitation / note: Coconut is listed in the filling but the original method does not say when to add it; no mixing step is invented. Dip the cutting knife in hot water and wipe between cuts.

Source: Desserts\Cookies\Pecan Coconut Triangles.pdf. Ingredient facts reviewed from the supplied source; directions independently summarized. Original file unchanged.

recipes/desserts/cookies/quaker-oatmeal-.body_html:
Ingredients

  • 1 cup margarine
  • 1 cup packed brown sugar
  • 1/2 cup granulated sugar
  • 2 eggs
  • 1 tsp vanilla
  • 1 1/2 cups flour
  • 1 tsp baking soda
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 3 cups oats

Instructions

  1. Heat oven to 350 F. Cream margarine and sugars; mix in eggs and vanilla.
  2. Mix in flour, salt, and soda, then oats. Drop portions on a sheet and bake 10-12 minutes.

Recipe source: More Recipes / Desserts / Cookies / Quaker Oatmeal Cookies.pdf. Original source files are unchanged.

recipes/desserts/cookies/reeses-peanut-b.body_html:
Ingredients

  • 1 cup soft butter
  • 2 eggs
  • 1 cup brown sugar
  • 1 cup white sugar
  • 1 cup creamy peanut butter
  • 1 tsp vanilla
  • 2 1/2 cups flour
  • 1 1/2 tsp baking soda
  • 1 tsp salt
  • 2 bags Reese's Peanut Butter Cups

Instructions

  1. Mix butter, eggs, sugars, peanut butter, and vanilla; blend in flour, soda, and salt.
  2. Chill until manageable. Roll balls smaller than a walnut and place in a mini muffin pan.
  3. Bake at 350 F 8-9 minutes. Press a peanut butter cup into each cookie immediately after baking; twist to release from the pan.

Source limitation / note: Makes 80; bag sizes unspecified.

Source: Desserts\Cookies\Reese's Peanut Butter Cookies.pdf. Ingredient facts reviewed from the supplied source; directions independently summarized. Original file unchanged.

recipes/desserts/pies/ivy-house-southern.body_html:
Ingredients

  • 1 thin, rich 8-inch pie crust
  • 2 large eggs
  • 2/3 cup yellow sugar
  • 2/3 cup white Karo syrup
  • 2/3 cup chopped pecans
  • 1/3 tbsp vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Heat oven to 300 F. Beat eggs lightly until frothy, then beat in sugar about 1 minute.
  2. Mix in syrup, pecans, and vanilla; pour into the unbaked crust.
  3. Bake 55-60 minutes.

Source limitation / note: Makes one 8-inch pie.

recipes/pork/cafe-rio-pork.html.body_html:
Ingredients

Pork

  • 3 lb pork roast
  • 16 oz salsa
  • 1 can Dr. Pepper, size unspecified
  • 2 cups brown sugar
  • Water to half-fill crockpot

Dressing

  • 1 envelope buttermilk ranch dressing
  • 1 cup milk
  • 1 cup mayonnaise
  • 1/2 bunch cilantro
  • 2 tomatillos
  • 2 serrano peppers, seeded

Rice

  • 1 cup rice
  • 2 cups water
  • 3 cubes chicken bouillon
  • 1/2 tsp dried onion
  • 1/4 bunch cilantro
  • 1 tbsp oil
  • 1 lime

Assembly

  • Black or pinto beans, amount unspecified
  • Mozzarella cheese, amount unspecified
  • Cooked tortillas, amount unspecified
  • Corn, optional

Instructions

  1. Cook pork on low with water halfway up the crockpot for 4 hours. Drain and cut into 3-4 pieces.
  2. Combine salsa, Dr. Pepper, and sugar; add to pork and cook on low 4 more hours. Shred about 10 minutes before serving.
  3. Blend dressing ingredients; refrigerate or let thicken.
  4. Cook rice with its listed ingredients except lime; then mix in juice of half the lime.
  5. Fill cooked tortillas with beans, cheese, rice, pork, and optional corn. Add 1/4 cup dressing inside and another 1/4 cup on top after folding.

Source limitation / note: Source times are estimates: verify safe pork doneness. Can size, ranch-packet size, tortilla count, and unused half-lime purpose are unspecified.

Source: Pork\Cafe Rio Pork.pdf. Ingredient facts reviewed from the supplied source; directions independently summarized. Original file unchanged.

recipes/pork/cajun-pork-chops.html.body_html:
Ingredients

  • 1 tbsp paprika
  • 1/2 tsp ground cumin
  • 1/2 tsp rubbed sage
  • 1/2 tsp freshly ground pepper
  • 1/2 tsp garlic powder
  • 1/2 tsp cayenne, to taste
  • 1/2 tbsp butter
  • 1/2 tbsp oil
  • 4 boneless center-cut pork chops, thickness printed as 1/2 without a unit
  • Salt, mentioned in method; amount unspecified

Instructions

  1. Combine paprika, salt, sage, pepper, garlic powder, and cayenne; coat both sides of the chops.
  2. Heat butter and oil in a skillet on high. Add chops, reduce to medium, and cook 8-9 minutes, turning halfway.
  3. The source also allows grilling until done.

Source limitation / note: Cumin is listed but omitted from the source method, and salt is used without a listed amount. Thickness unit is missing. Times are estimates, not proof of safe doneness.

Source: Pork\Cajun Pork Chops.pdf. Ingredient facts reviewed from the supplied source; directions independently summarized. Original file unchanged.

recipes/pork/ribs.html.body_html:
Ingredients

Rub

  • 1 tbsp garlic powder
  • 1 tbsp onion powder
  • 1 tbsp salt
  • 1 tbsp cayenne
  • 1 tbsp black pepper
  • 1 tbsp white pepper
  • 1 cup brown sugar
  • 1/2 cup paprika

Cooking

  • Ribs, weight unspecified
  • Apple juice, 3 parts in mop mixture
  • Oil, 1 part in mop mixture
  • BBQ sauce, amount unspecified
  • Hot water for drip pan

Instructions

  1. Apply rub the night before; wrap and refrigerate ribs overnight.
  2. The source says to take ribs out 1 hour before cooking. Heat oven to 225 F and place hot water in a pan on the lowest rack.
  3. Cook ribs bone-side down on a wire rack above the water pan so drippings fall into it.
  4. After 1 1/2 hours, apply the apple-juice/oil mop every 1/2-3/4 hour.
  5. The source checks for meat pulling back from bones or an easy toothpick insertion, and applies BBQ sauce 20 minutes before eating.

Source limitation / note: Rib weight and total cook time are missing. Source doneness cues are not a safe internal-temperature guarantee; do not treat this as a complete timing specification.

Source: Pork\Ribs.pdf. Ingredient facts reviewed from the supplied source; directions independently summarized. Original file unchanged.

recipes/pork/walnut-crusted-pork-chops-w.body_html:
Ingredients

Pork

  • 4 trimmed 8-oz bone-in center-cut pork chops
  • 1 1/2 tsp Worcestershire sauce
  • 3/4 tsp kosher salt
  • 2 tsp Dijon mustard
  • 1 tsp dry sherry
  • 1 tsp honey
  • 1/2 tsp dried sage
  • 1/4 tsp freshly ground black pepper
  • 1/3 cup finely ground walnuts
  • 1 bacon slice
  • 1/4 cup chicken broth

Rice

  • Cooking spray
  • 1 cup finely chopped onion
  • 1/2 cup diced carrot
  • 2 tsp diced seeded jalapeno, optional
  • 1 minced garlic clove
  • 1 1/2 cups finely chopped spinach
  • 1 cup sliced mushrooms
  • 1 cup chopped peeled Granny Smith apple
  • 2 cups cooked wild rice
  • 1/2 cup chicken broth
  • 1/4 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley

Instructions

  1. Drizzle Worcestershire over chops. Mix salt, Dijon, sherry, honey, sage, and pepper; reserve 1 tsp of that mixture. Add walnuts to the remainder, coat chops, and refrigerate 30 minutes.
  2. Cook bacon crisp, remove and crumble. Brown chops in drippings 1 1/2 minutes per side. Add 1/4 cup broth, cover, reduce heat, and cook about 6 minutes; remove chops.
  3. In a sprayed saucepan over medium heat, cook onion, carrot, optional jalapeno, and garlic covered for 5 minutes.
  4. Add the reserved seasoning, spinach, mushrooms, and apple; cover 5 minutes until carrot is tender. Stir in bacon.
  5. Serve 1 cup rice mixture with each chop, pan drippings, and 1 tbsp parsley.

Source limitation / note: Incomplete source method: it lists cooked wild rice and 1/2 cup broth but omits their addition. It reserves 1 tsp seasoning but later says 3/4 tsp. These gaps are preserved, not guessed. Verify safe pork doneness.

Attribution: elgourmand2, supplied recipe printout

Source: Pork\Walnut Crusted Pork Chops With Wild Rice.pdf. Ingredient facts reviewed from the supplied source; directions independently summarized. Original file unchanged.

recipes/vegetarian-tofu/thai-sticky-rice.body_html:
Ingredients

  • Sticky rice, amount unspecified
  • Cool water for soaking, 2-3 inches above rice
  • 6-8 cups water for steaming

Instructions

  1. Rinse rice 2-3 times, until water runs clear
  2. Place rinsed rice in a bowl and fill with cool water so the water is approximately 2-3 inches above the rice…let the rice stand in water for 6-8 hours
  3. Drain the rice, place it in cheesecloth, wrap it up and put the cheesecloth inside bamboo steamer. Put 6-8 cups of water in sticky rice steamer and bring to a boil. Then place bamboo steamer inside sticky rice steamer. Be sure the bottom of the bamboo steamer does not touch the boiling water. Place a standard 8 inch lid loosely over the top of the bamboo steamer.
  4. Steam the rice for 45 minutes (or until tender)
  5. Enjoy!

Source limitation / note: The source specifies no rice quantity; it has not been invented.

Source: Vegetarian (Tofu)\Thai Sticky Rice.docx. Ingredient facts reviewed from the supplied source; directions independently summarized. Original file unchanged.
